description:
Manage your personas (the on-camera presenter, voice and defaults). list: names and ids. get: one persona with its image count and bound publishing accounts. create: a face is REQUIRED (avatarUrl or avatarPath (a local photo, uploaded directly)) and at least one publishing account (accounts); a voiceover video is chosen per video, not per persona. update: only the given fields change (identityCard sets or, with null, removes the identity card; see persona_media get_card and render_prompt). delete: preview first, then confirm with the token. To rebind the accounts a persona publishes to, use accounts (action: set_persona_publishing); personas (action: get) only shows them.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); get (persona); create (name, voiceId, accounts); update (persona); delete (persona).

accounts.description: Publishing accounts this persona is bound to, per provider, e.g. { youtube: ["UC..."], bluesky: ["did:plc:..."] }. At least one account is required. Account IDs come from accounts (action: list) (channelId / igUserId / providerAccountId / did).

action.description: What to do: list | get | create | update | delete. The description lists the fields each action needs.

avatarPath.description: Local file path to the persona face photo (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB), uploaded directly. Use instead of avatarUrl for your own photo.

avatarUrl.description: Public URL to the persona avatar image (use persona_media (action: list_faces) for stock face URLs). Give exactly one of avatarUrl or avatarPath: every persona has a face; a video without lip sync is chosen per video with generate_video options.videoType: 'voiceover'.

confirmToken.description: Omit it first: the call only previews what would be removed and returns a token. Send that token to delete.

faceQuality.description: Face resolution of the rendered videos: ok (480p, 2 tokens/video) or very_good (720p, 3 tokens/video)

hookPanel.description: hook_lipsync default: true shows the segment photo in a panel under the talking face during the hook, false keeps the face alone.

anyOf.description: The persona's identity card: a versioned JSON object { version: 1, identity: { face, body }, defaults: { outfit } } of at most 4096 bytes. Every level is strict (an unknown key is rejected) and every trait is one line of at most 80 characters. It describes a real person's physical traits: fill it only with their consent. The server stores it and renders prompts from it; it never generates an image.

identityCard.description: The identity card to store. null stores none (the same as leaving it out).

imagePrimaryIndex.description: Index into images[] marking the primary library image (no primary is set when omitted)

images.description: Up to 10 local image files of the same person for the persona image library. Each video deterministically picks the best-matching image by tag.

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

language.description: Language code — English only for now (e.g. en-US, en-GB)

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

scriptPrompt.description: System prompt instructions for video scripts

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material: "standard" fills the frame with the avatar, "react" splits it in half (persona on top, video material below: real clips or drawings). Same render cost either way.

voiceId.description: id or label from voices (action: list). Never type a provider prefix.

name: personas
